# Spotlight

> Spotlight is a futuristic digital media and marketing agency. Tagline: "Where marketing meets intelligence." AI drafts and monitors; people approve every post, budget move, pitch and negotiation.

## Services
- Digital marketing: content calendars, brand-voice copy, scheduling and publishing (Instagram, X, LinkedIn, Meta), Meta and Google Ads with budget pacing recommendations, automated weekly and monthly reporting.
- PR intelligence: trade press and social monitoring, sentiment scoring, daily digest. Pitching is always done by people.
- Creative production: multi-format resizing, rough cuts for Reels and Shorts, template-driven social design.
- Influencer campaigns: creator discovery and tracked brief-to-approval workflow. Negotiation is always human.

## Principles
- Every post, caption and budget change is approved by a person before it goes live.
- No automated journalist pitching or influencer negotiation.

## Platform roadmap
- Phase 0 Foundation (2 weeks), Phase 1 Digital marketing (weeks 3-10), Phase 2 PR intelligence (4 weeks), Phase 3 Creative tooling (3 weeks), Phase 4 Influencer light tooling (2 weeks).
